title: Newsroom runtime ignores the selected publication root during attachment hydration
description:
The newsroom runtime hard-codes its shared code checkout as PAPYRUS_ROOT, ignoring the explicit publication root already supported by papyrus_content.env. In the TI OpenCode trial, genuine matching outputs exist in the publication checkout and assignment text attachments are byte-verified, but runtime hydration returns no text because it looks in the shared checkout. Reuse the existing root resolver; preserve the configured Biblicus directory. No tenant adoption, schema fallback, budget implementation, deployment or paid execution.

Feature: Selected publication root for newsroom runtime
  Scenario: Hydrate stored assignment text from the selected publication
    Given an explicit publication root with genuine storage configuration
    And stored brief and instructions for an assignment
    When the newsroom runtime reads assignment context
    Then it reads text from that publication storage
    And it uses the configured knowledge work directory
  Scenario: Preserve default root behavior
    Given no explicit publication root
    When the newsroom runtime starts
    Then it uses the existing content runtime root resolution

Scope: minimal constant binding correction and isolated regression tests; non-paid live verification using the existing TI records and outputs. Keep procedure disabled, preserve all draft versions and legacy data. No merges or deployments.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Root resolver reuse fixes publication selection, but live verification exposed an existing direct-S3 HeadObject 403 for the authoring role. No IAM changes or denied S3 retries. Extend the minimal fix to use the existing supported ModelAttachment download reader, already proven to authorize/download these exact objects, instead of shelling out to S3. This is the existing API path, not new infrastructure or auth. Add regression coverage through the public assignment-context method and preserve all record IDs/tenant state.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Implemented on fix/PPY-98af-newsroom-publication-root from origin/develop. The newsroom now reuses papyrus_content.env root resolution (PAPYRUS_ROOT and BIBLICUS_WORKDIR), and assignment text downloads use the existing authorized ModelAttachment download API rather than direct AWS S3 calls. Denied attachment reads propagate instead of silently removing guidance. No IAM, backend, tenant adoption, budget, or editorial-context changes.

Regression proof: original hardcoded-root implementation failed the publication hydration scenario; the root-only patch then failed direct-S3-denied regression. Final patch passed 29 focused pytest tests, 15 existing newsroom tests (113 deselected), two Behave scenarios/eight steps, pilot identifier guard and git diff --check.

Nonpaid live verification using the existing TI authoring role and genuine generated outputs hydrated the persisted 152-character brief and 1174-character instructions byte-for-byte. Procedure code hash remained a0d0901133abc83afac7109c3fabe9da05afb9182a48f12c9aa7a49c8c87eddd; definition remains disabled. OpenCode v2 remains current draft/reporting with nine consulted references and two preserved versions. Zero model calls; no run started. This explicitly loads the proposed local patch: it is not deployed, and the existing local canned-procedure symlink still points to the older runtime.

A subsequent read-only follow-up stopped before API access because papyrus-production SSO expired and refresh failed. The earlier successful verification is retained at ../opencode-reporting/setup-approved/root-fix-live-verification.json. Tenant-scoped frontend visibility remains unverified; no tenant was guessed/adopted and no legacy rows recreated. Human dollar ceiling plus enforceable shared model/search/retry budget remain separate blockers to paid execution. Keep this issue in_progress pending review/landing; draft PR will target develop, with no merge/deploy.
